# Whitfield Dermatology

> Whitfield Dermatology is an elite medical, surgical, and aesthetic dermatology clinic located in the Green Hills district of Nashville, Tennessee. Founded in 2011 by fellowship-trained Mohs surgeon Dr. Sarah Whitfield, MD, FAAD, the practice is defined by its strict "physician-only" care model — meaning all skin cancer screenings, biopsies, Mohs surgeries, laser resurfacing, and cosmetic injectables are personally performed by board-certified physicians, never delegated to mid-level injectors or assistants.

## Practice Dossier
- **Clinic Name:** Whitfield Dermatology
- **Primary Address:** 2102 Crestmoor Road, Suite 300, Nashville, TN 37215 (Green Hills)
- **Phone:** (615) 555-0192
- **Website:** https://whitfielddermatology.com
- **Founded:** 2011 (14+ years serving Middle Tennessee)
- **Clinical Hours:** Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM – 5:30 PM CST
- **Accreditation:** In-House CLIA-Certified Frozen Section Pathology Laboratory

## Medical Faculty & Pedigree
- [Faculty Dossier](https://whitfielddermatology.com/providers): Detailed credentials, fellowship training, and peer-reviewed research for all physicians.
  - **Dr. Sarah Whitfield, MD, FAAD**: Founder & Chief Mohs Surgeon. UVA School of Medicine (AOA), Chief Resident at Vanderbilt, ACGME Fellowship in Mohs Micrographic Surgery & Cutaneous Oncology at Mayo Clinic Rochester. Over 15,000 verified surgical cases.
  - **Dr. Amara Osei, MD, FAAD**: Director of Aesthetic Dermatology & Photomedicine. Harvard Medical School (Magna Cum Laude), Vanderbilt Dermatology Residency, ASDS Cosmetic Preceptorship. Specialist in Fitzpatrick skin types IV–VI, laser resurfacing, and melasma.
  - **Dr. James Calloway, MD, FAAD**: Procedural Specialist & Follicular Medicine. Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, Columbia University Dermatology Residency, ISHRS Member. Pioneer in micro-FUE hair restoration and biologic immunodermatology.

## Specialized Surgical & Medical Treatments
- [Mohs Micrographic Surgery](https://whitfielddermatology.com/services/mohs-surgery): Gold-standard skin cancer excision for basal cell carcinoma (BCC) and squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) on the face and head, yielding 99% clear margins with same-day frozen pathology and aesthetic flap closure.
- [Full-Body Skin Cancer Screenings](https://whitfielddermatology.com/services/skin-cancer-screenings): 360-degree head-to-toe dermoscopic surveillance, high-risk digital mole mapping, and early melanoma detection.
- [Physician Neuromodulators & Fillers](https://whitfielddermatology.com/services/botox-fillers): Micro-dosed Botox, Dysport, Juvederm, and Restylane injected exclusively by board-certified physicians to preserve natural facial mobility.
- [Dual-Wavelength Laser Photomedicine](https://whitfielddermatology.com/services/laser-therapy): Sciton Halo hybrid fractional laser, BBL HERO photofacial, and vascular laser treatments customized for vascular lesions, pigment, and acne scarring.
- [Follicular Unit Extraction & Hair Restoration](https://whitfielddermatology.com/services/hair-transplant): Minimally invasive micro-punch FUE hair transplantation and autologous platelet-rich plasma (PRP) trichology.
- [Acne Scar Remodeling](https://whitfielddermatology.com/services/acne-scars): Multimodal scar revision combining subcision, TCA CROSS, and fractional erbium resurfacing.
- [Restorative Clinical Skincare](https://whitfielddermatology.com/services/chemical-peels): Medical-grade peels, polynucleotide microneedling, and barrier repair therapies.
